description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'KpiServiceTest' for testing the 'KpiService' class in the 'OrangeHRM' Performance plugin, including methods for CRUD operations and exception handling related to KPIs.

classes.name: KpiServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of KpiService, including methods to test DAO retrieval, KPI saving, default KPI handling, and exception cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of KpiService and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetKpiDao
methods.description: Tests that the 'getKpiDao' method returns an instance of 'KpiDao'.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI entity via 'saveKpi' method, including mocking the DAO layer.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue
methods.description: Checks behavior when saving a KPI marked as default, ensuring it replaces existing default KPI.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue2
methods.description: Verifies that saving another KPI with default set to true unsets the previous default KPI, and updates ratings accordingly.

methods.name: testKpiServiceExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Ensures that saving a KPI with invalid min/max ratings throws 'KpiServiceException'.

methods.name: testTransactionExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Verifies that a transaction exception during saving triggers the correct exception.
